2026-01-22.reason: Core billing application reaches production-configuration milestone

2026-07-04.reason: Logistics becomes a new business workflow module

versioning.rule: Core billing is v1; introducing logistics is v2; introducing integrated stock management is v3. Major numbers track new business workflow modules, as requested. Within each milestone, curated dates that add user capabilities increment minor and reset patch; other dated fixes and maintenance increment patch. Dates represent development history, not independently verified deployments. Assistants and billing refinements extend existing workflows and are minor increments.
